--- source brief ---
# Fintech Disruption: Traditional Banking vs Digital Finance (2015–2024)

## Overview
Four datasets tracking the global shift from traditional banking to fintech-driven digital finance across four regions (North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, Latin America) over a ten-year period from 2015 to 2024.

## Data Source

### digital_payment_penetration
Annual digital payment adoption rate as a percentage of the adult population. Fields: `year` (integer, 2015–2024), `region` (string, 4 categories), `penetration_pct` (float, 18.3–91.2%). Represents share of adults who made at least one digital payment transaction in the year.

### traditional_bank_branches
Total number of physical bank branch locations in thousands. Fields: `year` (integer, 2015–2024), `region` (string, 4 categories), `branches_k` (float, 58.6–315.8 thousand). Covers commercial and retail bank branches.

### neobank_users
Cumulative registered users of digital-only banks (neobanks) in millions. Fields: `year` (integer, 2016–2024), `region` (string, 4 categories), `users_m` (float, 0.8–498.3 million). Starts from 2016 when neobanks began gaining traction.

### digital_bank_licenses
Cumulative count of full digital banking licenses approved by national regulators. Fields: `year` (integer, 2015–2024), `region` (string, 4 categories), `cumulative_licenses` (integer, 0–85).

## Data Notes
- All figures are estimated composites across countries within each region
- Digital payment penetration includes mobile wallets, online banking transfers, and contactless card payments
- Neobank user counts include registered accounts; active user rates vary by region
- License counts reflect full banking licenses only, excluding e-money or payment institution licenses
- The 2020 spike in digital adoption reflects pandemic-accelerated behavioral shifts

mkdir -p /app/output && cat > /tmp/render_chart.py <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.ticker as mticker
import pandas as pd
from matplotlib.gridspec import GridSpec
from matplotlib.lines import Line2D
from matplotlib.patches import Patch

DATA_PATH = Path('/app/benchmark/source_data.json')
OUTPUT_PATH = Path('/app/output/result.png')

source = json.loads(DATA_PATH.read_text())

def frame(name):
    return pd.DataFrame(source[name]['data'])

payments = frame('digital_payment_penetration')
branches = frame('traditional_bank_branches')
users = frame('neobank_users')
licenses = frame('digital_bank_licenses')

regions = ['North America', 'Europe', 'Asia-Pacific', 'Latin America']
region_colors = {
    'North America': '#4C78A8',
    'Europe': '#72B7B2',
    'Asia-Pacific': '#F58518',
    'Latin America': '#B279A2',
}
metric_colors = {
    'Digital payments': '#1B6CA8',
    'Digital banking licenses': '#2A9D8F',
    'Traditional branches': '#8A8F98',
}
branch_accent = '#B74E3C'
background = '#fffff8'
text = '#222222'
muted = '#666666'
light = '#D9D5C8'

plt.rcParams.update({
    'figure.facecolor': background,
    'axes.facecolor': background,
    'savefig.facecolor': background,
    'font.family': ['DejaVu Serif', 'Georgia', 'serif'],
    'axes.edgecolor': '#444444',
    'axes.labelcolor': text,
    'xtick.color': '#555555',
    'ytick.color': '#555555',
    'text.color': text,
    'axes.titleweight': 'semibold',
    'axes.titlesize': 15,
    'axes.labelsize': 11,
    'xtick.labelsize': 10,
    'ytick.labelsize': 10,
})

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16.2, 10.8), dpi=150)
gs = GridSpec(2, 2, figure=fig, height_ratios=[1.05, 1], hspace=0.42, wspace=0.22)

# --- Panel A: global indexed crossover dynamics ---
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
pay_global = payments.groupby('year')['penetration_pct'].mean().sort_index()
branch_global = branches.groupby('year')['branches_k'].sum().sort_index()
license_global = licenses.groupby('year')['cumulative_licenses'].sum().sort_index()

index = pd.DataFrame({
    'Digital payments': pay_global / pay_global.loc[2015] * 100,
    'Digital banking licenses': license_global / license_global.loc[2015] * 100,
    'Traditional branches': branch_global / branch_global.loc[2015] * 100,
})

for label, values in index.items():
    lw = 2.8 if label != 'Traditional branches' else 3.2
    ax1.plot(values.index, values.values, color=metric_colors[label], lw=lw, solid_capstyle='round')
    ax1.scatter(values.index[-1], values.iloc[-1], s=28, color=metric_colors[label], zorder=4)
    ax1.text(values.index[-1] + 0.15, values.iloc[-1], f"{label}\n{values.iloc[-1]:.0f}",
             color=metric_colors[label], va='center', fontsize=9.5, linespacing=1.1)

ax1.axhline(100, color=light, lw=1.0, zorder=0)
ax1.axvspan(2019.5, 2024.5, color='#F2E8DF', alpha=0.72, zorder=0)
ax1.text(2020.0, 640, 'Post-2019 acceleration window', fontsize=9.5, color='#6C5147')
ax1.annotate('Digital rails pull away as\nbranch networks contract', xy=(2020, index.loc[2020, 'Digital payments']),
             xytext=(2016.0, 500), arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='-', color='#777777', lw=0.9),
             fontsize=10.5, color=text)
ax1.set_title('Digital finance scales while branch networks shrink', loc='left', pad=10)
ax1.set_ylabel('Index, 2015 = 100')
ax1.set_xlabel('Year')
ax1.set_xlim(2015, 2025.8)
ax1.set_ylim(60, 700)
ax1.set_xticks(range(2015, 2025, 2))
ax1.yaxis.set_major_formatter(mticker.StrMethodFormatter('{x:.0f}'))
ax1.grid(axis='y', color='#000000', alpha=0.09, lw=0.7)
ax1.spines[['top', 'right']].set_visible(False)
ax1.spines['left'].set_bounds(60, 700)
ax1.spines['bottom'].set_bounds(2015, 2024)

# --- Panel B: branch decline acceleration ---
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
branch_pivot = branches.pivot(index='year', columns='region', values='branches_k').loc[:, regions]
closures = -branch_pivot.diff().dropna()
years = closures.index.to_list()
bottom = pd.Series(0, index=closures.index, dtype=float)
for region in regions:
    vals = closures[region]
    ax2.bar(vals.index, vals.values, bottom=bottom.values, width=0.72,
            color=region_colors[region], edgecolor=background, linewidth=0.7, label=region)
    bottom += vals

# Highlight 2020 and sustained period
ax2.axvspan(2019.5, 2024.5, color='#F2E8DF', alpha=0.55, zorder=0)
peak_year = int(bottom.idxmax())
peak_value = float(bottom.max())
pre_2020 = float(bottom.loc[2019])
ax2.annotate(f'Closures nearly double\nfrom {pre_2020:.1f}k in 2019\nto {bottom.loc[2020]:.1f}k in 2020',
             xy=(2020, bottom.loc[2020]), xytext=(2016.25, peak_value * 0.88),
             arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='-', color='#777777', lw=0.9), fontsize=10.2)
ax2.text(2021.65, 2.2, 'Elevated closure rate persists', color='#6C5147', fontsize=9.6)
ax2.set_title('Traditional branch closures accelerated after 2019', loc='left', pad=10)
ax2.set_ylabel('Annual branch closures (thousand locations)')
ax2.set_xlabel('Year')
ax2.set_xlim(2015.4, 2024.7)
ax2.set_ylim(0, peak_value * 1.20)
ax2.set_xticks(range(2016, 2025, 2))
ax2.grid(axis='y', color='#000000', alpha=0.09, lw=0.7)
ax2.spines[['top', 'right']].set_visible(False)
ax2.spines['left'].set_bounds(0, peak_value * 1.15)
ax2.spines['bottom'].set_bounds(2016, 2024)

# --- Panel C: neobank user surge ---
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
user_pivot = users.pivot(index='year', columns='region', values='users_m').loc[:, regions]
for region in regions:
    vals = user_pivot[region]
    ax3.plot(vals.index, vals.values, color=region_colors[region], lw=2.6, solid_capstyle='round')
    ax3.scatter(vals.index[-1], vals.iloc[-1], color=region_colors[region], s=24, zorder=4)
    ax3.text(vals.index[-1] + 0.14, vals.iloc[-1], f"{region}\n{vals.iloc[-1]:.1f}m",
             color=region_colors[region], va='center', fontsize=9.4, linespacing=1.08)
ax3.annotate('Asia-Pacific leads adoption\nwith 498.3m registered users', xy=(2024, user_pivot.loc[2024, 'Asia-Pacific']),
             xytext=(2017.1, 430), arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='-', color='#777777', lw=0.9),
             fontsize=10.2)
ax3.set_title('Neobank users surge, led by Asia-Pacific', loc='left', pad=10)
ax3.set_ylabel('Registered users (millions)')
ax3.set_xlabel('Year')
ax3.set_xlim(2016, 2025.65)
ax3.set_ylim(0, 540)
ax3.set_xticks(range(2016, 2025, 2))
ax3.grid(axis='y', color='#000000', alpha=0.09, lw=0.7)
ax3.spines[['top', 'right']].set_visible(False)
ax3.spines['left'].set_bounds(0, 500)
ax3.spines['bottom'].set_bounds(2016, 2024)

# --- Panel D: regulatory license wave ---
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
license_pivot = licenses.pivot(index='year', columns='region', values='cumulative_licenses').loc[:, regions]
approvals = license_pivot.diff().fillna(license_pivot)
bottom = pd.Series(0, index=approvals.index, dtype=float)
for region in regions:
    vals = approvals[region]
    ax4.bar(vals.index, vals.values, bottom=bottom.values, width=0.72,
            color=region_colors[region], edgecolor=background, linewidth=0.7)
    bottom += vals

ax4.axvspan(2019.5, 2022.5, color='#E8F1EC', alpha=0.82, zorder=0)
cluster_total = int(bottom.loc[2020:2022].sum())
all_total = int(bottom.sum())
ax4.annotate(f'License approvals cluster\nin 2020–2022: {cluster_total} of {all_total}',
             xy=(2021, bottom.loc[2021]), xytext=(2015.7, max(bottom) * 0.84),
             arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='-', color='#777777', lw=0.9), fontsize=10.2)
ax4.set_title('Regulators issue digital-bank licenses in waves', loc='left', pad=10)
ax4.set_ylabel('New digital banking licenses (count)')
ax4.set_xlabel('Year')
ax4.set_xlim(2014.4, 2024.7)
ax4.set_ylim(0, max(bottom) * 1.18)
ax4.set_xticks(range(2015, 2025, 2))
ax4.grid(axis='y', color='#000000', alpha=0.09, lw=0.7)
ax4.spines[['top', 'right']].set_visible(False)
ax4.spines['left'].set_bounds(0, max(bottom) * 1.1)
ax4.spines['bottom'].set_bounds(2015, 2024)

# Shared legend: region colors and metric encodings kept compact.
region_handles = [Patch(facecolor=region_colors[r], edgecolor='none', label=r) for r in regions]
metric_handles = [Line2D([0], [0], color=metric_colors[m], lw=3, label=m) for m in metric_colors]
legend1 = fig.legend(handles=region_handles, loc='lower left', bbox_to_anchor=(0.058, 0.012),
